title: The Coming of the Lord Omnipotent
summary: “the Lord Omnipotent who reigneth, who was, and is from all eternity to all eternity, shall come down from heaven among the children of men, and shall dwell in a tabernacle of clay, and shall go forth amongst men, working mighty miracles,” “And he shall cast out devils, or the evil spirits which dwell in the hearts of the children of men.”

And he shall cast out devils, or the evil spirits which dwell in the hearts of the children of men.
